intended_object: The canonical projection X → X/R from an affine scheme X onto the coequalizer, in the category of affine schemes, of a pair of morphisms s, t : R ⇉ X. This is Spec of the inclusion of the invariant ring {f ∈ Γ(X) | s*f = t*f} into Γ(X). Inferred from the docstring and from the module documentation.
explanation: The body is exactly `coequalizer.π s t` in the category `AffineScheme.{u}`. Its target `quotient s t` is defined directly above it as `coequalizer s t`. So this is the canonical morphism to the categorical coequalizer, which is what the docstring says: "the canonical map from X to the affine coequalizer". The `HasCoequalizer` instance comes from Mathlib, because `AffineScheme` has all colimits (it is anti-equivalent to commutative rings). The construction is the general categorical one, applied to the affine-scheme setting that the file is about, so it is not too narrow. It is a thin alias for Mathlib's `coequalizer.π`, and it is faithful.
